title: Active Queries and Connections
description: Show all active database connections and their current queries, including execution duration.
sql:
SELECT pid, age(clock_timestamp(), query_start) AS duration, usename, query, state
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state != 'idle'
  AND query NOT LIKE '%pg_stat_activity%'
ORDER BY duration DESC;

title: Kill Idle & Blocking Sessions
description: Hentikan koneksi atau transaksi yang menggantung (idle in transaction) menggunakan pg_terminate_backend agar tidak mengunci tabel.
sql:
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid),
       pid,
       usename,
       state,
       age(clock_timestamp(), query_start) AS duration,
       query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid()
  AND state = 'idle in transaction'
ORDER BY duration DESC;

title: Check Primary Key Coverage per Schema
description: Menampilkan seluruh tabel dalam skema tertentu beserta status kepemilikan Primary Key (YES/NO) dan daftar kolom kunci primernya.
sql:
SELECT 
    n.nspname AS schema_name,
    t.relname AS table_name,
    CASE WHEN pk.conname IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS has_primary_key,
    array_agg(a.attname ORDER BY a.attnum) FILTER (WHERE a.attname IS NOT NULL) AS primary_key_columns
FROM pg_class t
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_constraint pk ON pk.conrelid = t.oid AND pk.contype = 'p'
LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = ANY(pk.conkey)
WHERE t.relkind = 'r'
  AND n.nspname = 'public' -- Ganti dengan skema target jika perlu
GROUP BY n.nspname, t.relname, pk.conname
ORDER BY has_primary_key ASC, t.relname;

title: Find Tables by Column Name
description: Mencari tabel dan skema mana saja yang memiliki kolom dengan nama tertentu di database.
sql:
SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE column_name ILIKE '%nama_kolom%'
  AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name;

title: Scan Tables with NULL Values
description: Blok prosedur dinamis PL/pgSQL untuk memindai seluruh tabel dan kolom di skema publik yang memiliki baris bernilai NULL.

title: Data Dictionary & Column Comments
description: Menampilkan kamus data lengkap setiap tabel beserta tipe data, ukuran, nullable, dan komentar/deskripsi kolom dari pg_description.
sql:
SELECT 
    c.table_name,
    c.column_name,
    c.data_type,
    c.character_maximum_length,
    c.is_nullable,
    pgd.description AS column_description
FROM information_schema.columns c
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_statio_all_tables st
       ON c.table_schema = st.schemaname 
      AND c.table_name = st.relname
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description pgd 
       ON pgd.objoid = st.relid 
      AND pgd.objsubid = c.ordinal_position
WHERE c.table_schema = 'public'
ORDER BY c.table_name, c.ordinal_position;

title: List All Indexes & Definitions
description: Menampilkan seluruh indeks dalam skema target beserta perintah DDL pembuatannya dari pg_indexes.
sql:
SELECT 
    schemaname,
    tablename,
    indexname,
    indexdef
FROM pg_indexes
WHERE schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY tablename, indexname;

title: Search Functions by Code Definition
description: Mencari nama stored function/procedure di pg_proc berdasarkan potongan isi kode atau logika di dalamnya.
sql:
SELECT 
    n.nspname AS schema_name,
    p.proname AS function_name,
    pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,
    pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition
FROM pg_proc p
JOIN pg_namespace n ON p.pronamespace = n.oid
WHERE p.prokind = 'f'
  AND pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ILIKE '%KEYWORD%'
ORDER BY schema_name, function_name;

title: Disable or Enable All Triggers
description: Menonaktifkan seluruh trigger pada skema untuk keperluan migrasi atau bulk loading data, serta perintah untuk mengaktifkannya kembali.
sql:
-- 1. Menonaktifkan SEMUA trigger pada seluruh tabel di skema 'public':
DO $$
DECLARE
    r RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR r IN
        SELECT quote_ident(n.nspname) || '.' || quote_ident(c.relname) AS table_name
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname = 'public'
    LOOP
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE ' || r.table_name || ' DISABLE TRIGGER ALL;';
    END LOOP;
END;
$$;

-- 2. Mengaktifkan KEMBALI semua trigger setelah selesai proses data:
-- Ganti 'DISABLE TRIGGER ALL' menjadi 'ENABLE TRIGGER ALL' pada loop di atas.

title: Global Text Search Across All Tables
description: Fungsi dinamis PL/pgSQL untuk mencari string atau nomor ID ke seluruh tabel dan kolom teks di database secara otomatis.

title: Database User Security & Privileges Template
description: Panduan standar pembuatan user database dengan isolasi hak akses, pembatasan koneksi, dan konfigurasi ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES.

title: Transfer Ownership of All Tables & Objects
description: Skrip massal untuk mengganti pemilik (owner) seluruh tabel, sequence, dan view ke role/user baru.

title: Find Duplicate Rows in Table
description: Mendeteksi data baris yang terduplikasi berdasarkan kombinasi kolom tertentu menggunakan agregasi GROUP BY dan HAVING count(*) > 1.
sql:
SELECT kolom_kunci_1, kolom_kunci_2, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_duplikat
FROM nama_tabel
GROUP BY kolom_kunci_1, kolom_kunci_2
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY jumlah_duplikat DESC;

title: Database Sizes
description: List all databases in the server along with their size on disk, formatted nicely.
sql:
SELECT pg_database.datname,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(pg_database.datname)) AS size
FROM pg_database
ORDER BY pg_database_size(pg_database.datname) DESC;

title: Table Size Breakdown
description: Show size breakdown of tables in the current database, including table size, index size, and total size.
sql:
SELECT relname AS table_name,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_size,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS table_size,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) - pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS index_size
FROM pg_class c
LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
  AND c.relkind = 'r'
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC
LIMIT 20;

title: Unused Indexes
description: Identify indexes that are rarely or never scanned, which consume disk space and slow down writes.
sql:
SELECT schemaname, relname AS table_name, indexrelname AS index_name,
       idx_scan AS number_of_scans, idx_tup_read, idx_tup_fetch
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
WHERE idx_scan = 0
  AND indexrelname NOT LIKE 'pg_%'
ORDER BY relname, indexrelname;

title: Cache Hit Rate (Tables & Indexes)
description: Calculate how often data is read from the cache vs. disk. Ideally, it should be > 99%.
sql:
SELECT 
  'table' AS type,
  sum(heap_blks_hit) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(heap_blks_read) + sum(heap_blks_hit), 0) AS ratio
FROM pg_statio_user_tables
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'index' AS type,
  sum(idx_blks_hit) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(idx_blks_read) + sum(idx_blks_hit), 0) AS ratio
FROM pg_statio_user_indexes;

title: Duplicate Indexes
description: Find redundant indexes (indexes on the same column set in the same order) that consume storage.
sql:
SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid)) AS size,
       i.indrelid::regclass AS table_name,
       i.indexrelid::regclass AS index_name,
       array_to_string(array_agg(a.attname), ', ') AS columns
FROM pg_index i
JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indexrelid
GROUP BY i.indrelid, i.indexrelid, i.indisunique
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid) DESC;
